## Summary

What changed and why?

## Evidence

What metric, test, or reproducible case supports the change?

## Safety / scope check

- [ ] No credentials, private endpoints/IPs, provider account details, customer data, or production captures are included.
- [ ] Missing-data behavior remains explicit.
- [ ] Descriptive comparisons are not presented as causal proof.
- [ ] Public/private implementation boundaries are preserved.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated when behavior changed.
- [ ] Local tests and repository hygiene checks pass.
